evidence: docs/feasibility.md section 8; measured across all 5,347,869 holding rows of the 2026Q2 DERA bulk N-PORT data set
gate: Week 1 universe freeze. Additions occur only at a version boundary, and a boundary is treated as a discontinuity in every series.
selection_criteria: A full member must have enough distinct filers in a single quarter to support cross-manager dispersion analysis. The observed floor is 28 distinct submissions (Cerebras); everything below that gap falls to 12 or fewer.
Membership is decided on Level 3 equity rows only. Bank debt, 144A bonds and other instruments priced per $100 of face value are excluded even when the issuer name matches.
A company whose name matches only a public company is not in the universe regardless of row count.
Companies with real but insufficient coverage are carried with an explicit thin-coverage label: their marks are published, their dispersion is not.

members.rationale: Widest coverage in the cohort by a factor of two. Also the heaviest entity-resolution load at 50 distinct name spellings, and its price range spans 0.00 to 8,876,589.86 in a single quarter, so unit artifacts and null balances must be handled before any series is computed.

Added at v1; not in the plan.md universe. Coverage exceeds four companies that were listed. Carries the documented 10x common-versus-preferred unit artifact (204.64 to 5,265.90), which makes it a useful split-detector test case as well as a subject.
The hand-verified reference company. Six managers reproduced to the cent across a repricing event, so it is the regression anchor for the whole pipeline.
Strong coverage and a tight observed price band (653.30 to 693.90). No LEI, so it exercises the fuzzy-name path with no short-circuit available.
Clears the 50-fund threshold with every row at Level 3. Has an LEI, so it tests the LEI short-circuit against the fuzzy matcher.

Lowest coverage of the full members, retained deliberately: it went public during the observation window, giving a Level 3 to Level 1 event study. That is the only available external check on whether these marks mean anything, and it cannot be reconstructed from any other company.

carried_thin.rationale: Real but sparse. Marks are published; dispersion and propagation are suppressed and the coverage count is stated in every output.

excluded.name: Cohere Inc.
excluded.detail: A %COHERE% substring match returns 1,094 rows, all of them Coherent Corp, a public NYSE optics company, across three spellings and zero at Level 3. Real Cohere has no 2026Q2 presence. plan.md attributed 32 hits to Cohere via the Private Shares Fund; that count did not survive measurement. Retained as golden-set case: a confident, entirely fictitious series is the failure this excludes.

excluded.name: X.AI Corp
excluded.detail: 58 matching rows but only 7 are Level 3 equity (x.AI, Inc.). The remainder are X.AI LLC TL 1L BANKDEBT and X.AI LLC/X.AI CO ISSUER 144A, priced per $100 of face value, which is why the observed range starts at 0.97. Equity coverage alone is below the threshold. Revisit at v2 if equity positions grow.

excluded.name: Perplexity AI, Inc.
excluded.detail: 7 rows across 6 funds. Below the threshold for cross-manager dispersion; publishing marks without comparison would misrepresent the project's output.

excluded.name: Scale AI, Inc.
excluded.detail: Zero rows in 2026Q2. Confirms the plan.md finding that Scale AI has no N-PORT presence following the Meta transaction.

revisit_at_v2: X.AI Corp equity positions, if they grow past the coverage floor
Perplexity and Groq, if additional quarters show more holders
Any company surfacing in the 2019Q4-2026Q1 backfill that was not visible in the 2026Q2 snapshot
